](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-tatkalpan.html#english-01)   * Click [here](https://onlineservices.proteantech.in/paam/endUserRegisterContact.html) to select the type of PAN application.   * Fill the appropriate online form and select payment mode to complete the form submission.   * On successful submission of online application and payment (for online mode of payment), an Acknowledgement receipt is generated.   * Save and take a print out of the acknowledgement receipt.   * Duly sign in the space provided, affix recent color photographs and submit the PAN application with supporting documents as under:    1. Visit any of the [designated centre](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/downloads/List%20of%20centres%20for%20submission%20of%20online%20PAN%20documents.xls) and submit the said documents       OR;       2. Forward the said documents to       **INCOME TAX PAN SERVICES UNIT**    5th Floor, Mantri Sterling, Plot No. 341,    Survey No. 997/8, Model Colony,    Near Deep Bungalow Chowk,    Pune - 411016       * The 15 digit acknowledgement no. appearing on the acknowledgement receipt can be used for tracking status of application.  [ Who can apply for PAN? ](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-tatkalpan.html#english-collapseTwo) All existing assessees or taxpayers or persons who are required to file a return of income, even on behalf of others, must have a PAN. Any person, who intends to enter into economic or financial transactions where quoting PAN is mandatory, must also have a PAN. [ Are there any additional charges for applying for PAN online? ](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-tatkalpan.html#english-collapseThree) No. There are no **additional** charges for applying for PAN online. [ ऑनलाइन पैन आवेदन की प्रक्रिया क्या है? ](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-tatkalpan.html#hindi-collapseOne) * पैन आवेदन के प्रकार का चयन करने के लिए [यहां क्लिक करें](https://onlineservices.proteantech.in/paam/endUserRegisterContact.html) * उपयुक्त ऑनलाइन फॉर्म भरें और फॉर्म जमा करने के लिए भुगतान मोड़ का चयन करें। * सफलतापूर्वक ऑनलाइन आवेदन और भुगतान (ऑनलाइन भुगतान मोड़ के लिए) करने पर, एक पावती रसीद प्राप्त होगी।  * पावती रसीद को सेव करा लें और प्रिंट आउट निकाल लें।
